title: Kissed Keto Carnitas Quesadilla
description: A festive Mexican dish featuring sirloin steak, wood-fired-baked keto-friendly carnitas with a touch of herbal flavor.
instructions: Season the sirloin with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add half of the seasoning mixture to each side.
Place the sirloin on an aluminum foil-lined baking sheet, cover with another aluminum foil, and bake at 200°C for 15-20 minutes.

Mix lime juice, cumin powder, garlic powder, and remaining seasoning in a small bowl. Brush onto both sides of sirloin before grilling over applewood chips at medium heat for 3-4 minutes on each side or until internal temperature reaches 68°C.
In a pan, cook the keto cheese blend until melted and bubbly, then divide evenly into quesadillas with some grilled carnitas between them. Cook until golden brown and top with sliced jalapenos.
